notes.subject: yu ol
notes.rationale: Job turns to address his three friends directly, quoting their imagined words.

notes.subject: שרש דבר
notes.rationale: 'root of the matter' — Hebrew idiom for the underlying substance/cause of the case; rendered 'rot bilong ol tok' to keep the picture.

notes.subject: מה נרדף לו
notes.rationale: Read as a question ('why do we pursue him?') or an exclamation ('how we will persecute him!'); Tok Pisin keeps the question shape.

translation: Sapos yu ol i tok: 'Bilong wanem mipela i ran afta long em?' — na rot bilong ol tok i stap long mi.
